svg.title: Iron Stack Architecture — Zero-Cloud Second Brain and Adversarial Engineering Harness
svg.desc: System graph showing how curated Markdown, session history, and native rules flow through privacy scrubbing and project aliases into a local SQLite FTS5 store, serving native coding agents via stdio MCP and humans via the Second Brain Web UI in a closed verification loop.

g.text: IRON STACK ARCHITECTURE · ZERO-CLOUD · RUST · SQLITE FTS5
From Raw Agent Work to a Verified Second Brain
Deterministic local indexing, byte-bounded stdio MCP, interactive verification UI, and fresh-context adversarial skills.
Single authoritative local store — zero vector DBs, zero hosted APIs
• Hot memory.db: unicode61 FTS5 + SHA-256 deduped bodies
• Cold archive.db: read-only historical fallback store
• Online iron memory backup snapshots (0600, safe)
• Hard UTF-8 --max-bytes ceiling on serialized JSON
MULTI-MACHINE SHARED HUB OVER PLAIN SSH
One hub holds the canonical DB; any number of devices
connect via ssh iron-hub .local/bin/iron mcp — zero drift.
Pure-std HTTP/1.1 · Host allowlist + CSRF guard · strictly read-only inspect
CLOSED SELF-CORRECTION LOOP · confirms (+boost) · supersedes (0.15×) · merge-project (aliases.json) · backprop
NATIVE HARNESS ARCHITECTURE · ZERO VECTOR DB · ZERO CLOUD LOCK-IN · MIT LICENSE
